usage: deskops materialize [-h] [--root ROOT] [--out OUT] [--adr ADR]

Render tracked desk role prompts into installed pi-agent files, or one
atom.adr as Markdown (--adr).

options:
  -h, --help   show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT  Target repository root.
  --out OUT    Output directory override; defaults to ~/.pi/agent/agents (with
               --adr: the output file, default docs/decisions/<id>.md).
  --adr ADR    Materialize this atom.adr (id or selector) as Markdown instead
               of the role prompts.
